finalists.title: Scribe-Adjusted EBITDA: Privileged Diligence for Physician Deals
finalists.one_liner: A fixed-price, 10-business-day, counsel-engaged report that tells private equity buyers how much of a scribe-enabled physician group's revenue is real, and what the rest could cost them.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0389 ('Independent Auditor for AI-Scribed Billing'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Proving AI controls and human review to insurers, auditors and clients

finalists.title: Home Equity Assurance for Data Center Neighbors
finalists.one_liner: A neutral calculation agent runs a county-approved, developer-funded home-value guarantee for houses near proposed data centers, using pre-announcement baselines and public sale records with no sensors, and unspent escrow reverts to the developer, which makes it cheaper than $10k checks and more credible.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I1172 ('Neutral Baselines and Neighbor Guarantees for Data Centers'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Localities, utilities and landowners facing speculative data-center demand

finalists.title: Auto Loan-End Event Exchange for Add-On Refunds
finalists.one_liner: Start by recovering unearned add-on refunds on repossessed and charged-off loans for small lenders on pure contingency (cash the lender itself keeps), then turn those lender-attested loan-end events into a neutral exchange that administrators, carriers and regulators plug into, so refunds become a statutory event pushed to the administrator instead of a claim the borrower must pull.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0109 ('Payoff-Triggered Refund Recovery for Credit Unions'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Unclaimed money: settlements, refunds, penalties and unpaid invoices

finalists.title: ERCOT Large-Load Energization Files, Fixed Fee
finalists.one_liner: A two-engineer Texas specialist that sells neocloud and colo developers a fixed-fee, six-week package of ISO-acceptable PSS/E and EMT models, a ride-through study and a compliance file, with a fee kicker paid when ERCOT accepts it.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0996 ('Grid-Code Models for AI Data Centers'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Getting power for large loads and storage

finalists.title: Finish Crew: Stranded Solar Job Completion
finalists.one_liner: A completion contractor that takes half-built solar jobs abandoned by bankrupt installers all the way to permission-to-operate, and is paid by the lenders whose loans go bad while the system sits dark.
finalists.lineage: original (tournament survivor)
finalists.cluster: Residential solar leftovers: orphaned systems, leases and liens

finalists.title: Line-Keyed Cross-Examination Kits for LOP Defense
finalists.one_liner: A $395, 48-hour kit for defense counsel that turns a letter-of-protection bill into line-by-line cross-examination questions and a signed rebuttal, with the testifying coder as the real profit center.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0428 ('Coder-Signed Reasonable-Value Reports for Injury Defense'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Small litigation practices lacking evidence, records and benchmark tools

finalists.title: Cattle Lien Registry and Sale-Barn Exit Alerts
finalists.one_liner: Invert the problem: instead of counting cattle in the pasture, watch the few gates cattle must leave through. Start with consignment alerts to lenders and lien matching for auction markets, then grow into the neutral title registry for cattle.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0338 ('Chute-Side Cow Counts for Ag Lenders'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Lenders and investors unable to verify collateral exists

finalists.title: Lender-Required Curtailment Reports for Data Centers
finalists.one_liner: An independent, productized report, like a Phase I environmental report but for power, that tells data center lenders how many hours a campus can legally run its generators when the grid curtails it.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0836 ('Air-Permit Unlock for Idle Data Center Diesel'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Getting power for large loads and storage

finalists.title: Smoke Report Autopsy for Policyholder Advocates
finalists.one_liner: An adequacy auditor that scores any carrier-side smoke, ash and soot report against a public, versioned sampling grid. It then drafts the AB 1795 deficiency letter and supplemental sampling plan, and sells to public adjusters and plaintiff attorneys in the Eaton and Palisades zones.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0715 ('Interim Smoke-Damage Protocol Before the State Standard'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Flood and fire survivors: mapping, buyouts, claims and rebuilding

finalists.title: Cure Desk: Cash-Worker Packets for Health Centers
finalists.one_liner: A Spanish-first text-message case tool for health-center enrollment staff that turns a Medicaid noncompliance notice (or a pre-emptive look-back audit) into a state-formatted evidence packet for cash-paid workers, built on batch attestations from the crew leaders, landlords and households who pay them, billed per accepted packet.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0573 ('Medicaid Hours Wallet for Gig Workers'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Benefit-rule changes: Medicaid work rules, SNAP and ACA cliffs

finalists.title: China-Asset Diligence Desk for Pharma BD
finalists.one_liner: A bilingual scientist-plus-software sprint that verifies China-sourced drug packages (raw data, GLP and CMC standing, ownership chain) in 72 hours for US buyers.
finalists.lineage: original (tournament survivor)
finalists.cluster: Biotech capital: diligence and salvage

finalists.title: Independent Referee for Survey Panel Data
finalists.one_liner: An audit that tells research buyers what share of their online-panel responses came from bots, agents or fraud farms, and recalibrates the study against a verified-human control sample.
finalists.lineage: original (tournament survivor)
finalists.cluster: Gatekeepers drowning in AI-generated submissions and bot responses

finalists.title: Fixed-Price Guaranteed Clearance of Unknown Lead Lines
finalists.one_liner: Take the whole unknown-lines problem at a fixed price per line with an acceptance guarantee, and make money by routing each line to the cheapest method that will satisfy the state (records mining, meter-swap photos, paid photos, probe, pothole).
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0463 ('Pay Home Inspectors to Find Lead Pipes'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Small water utilities: staffing, revenue leakage, lead lines and nitrate

finalists.title: Phantom Pipeline Audits for Utility Rate-Case Intervenors
finalists.one_liner: Sell to the ratepayers who pay for phantom load, meaning industrial customer groups and state consumer advocates in IRP, CPCN and large-load-tariff dockets, a testimony-ready audit of how much of a utility's confidential data-center pipeline is physically real.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0079 ('Phantom Load Vetting Desk for Rural Utilities'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Localities, utilities and landowners facing speculative data-center demand

finalists.title: Satellite Witness for Neighbor Construction Claims
finalists.one_liner: A fixed-price, court-ready satellite-radar history of a condo tower's movement before and during the neighbor's pile-driving, sold through the plaintiff-side attorneys who represent Miami-Dade condo associations.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I1289 ('Settlement Passports for Florida High-Rise Condos'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Novel environmental and infrastructure data from satellites and crowd-sensing

finalists.title: Independent Collateral Verifier for Warehouse Lenders
finalists.one_liner: Sell the same listing-vs-ledger signal not to the floorplan lender but to the lender's lender: credit funds and banks that fund floorplan and subprime auto lenders and get a borrower-supplied VIN tape they have never been able to check, delivered as a signed monthly verification certificate that borrowers pay for through facility fees.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0218 ('Sold-Out-of-Trust Radar for Floorplan Lenders'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Lenders and investors unable to verify collateral exists

finalists.title: Work-Permit Gap Desk for Frontline Employers
finalists.one_liner: Employer-paid, pre-cliff delay suits for workers whose EAD renewals are pending, sold to home-care, nursing and staffing employers as a per-worker maintenance plan instead of a one-off legal purchase.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I1062 ('Delay-Suit Rails for Stuck Immigration Cases'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Immigrant households and workers: status deadlines and paperwork

finalists.title: Unit Tests for Benefit Law: Eligibility System Conformance
finalists.one_liner: Invert the drill: aim the same synthetic households and adjudicated answer keys at the eligibility software itself, selling H.R.1 conformance test packs to states and system vendors, with an aim to become the standard test suite that state RFPs cite.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I1240 ('Flight simulator drills for county SNAP eligibility workers'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Benefit-rule changes: Medicaid work rules, SNAP and ACA cliffs

finalists.title: Holdout Ledger: Landowner-Side Assembly Intelligence
finalists.one_liner: The landowner's half of the courthouse tape. It shows farm families and heirs in an assembly corridor who is buying around them, how close the buyer is to finishing, and how much leverage the last holdouts have, paid on closing.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0773 ('Courthouse Tape: Land-Assembly Radar for Infrastructure'), type: new-customer-or-model
finalists.cluster: Land and property facts trapped in county records

finalists.title: A Price Reporting Agency for Trade Materials
finalists.one_liner: Turn pooled supply-house invoices into contract-grade, SKU-level price evidence for the trades, starting with cost-change certificates that win price-adjustment change orders and ending as the index that escalation clauses and price-lock guarantees reference.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0068 ('Contingency Audit of Unbilled Plumbing Materials'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Small trade and service firms underpricing and leaking margin

finalists.title: Ruling-Backed Tariff Engineering for Product Brands
finalists.one_liner: A productized design-and-ruling service that helps mid-market brands legitimately re-spec products across tariff-line boundaries and locks the result in with a CBP binding ruling.
finalists.lineage: original (tournament survivor)
finalists.cluster: Tariff cost, classification and customs for small importers

finalists.title: The Pharmacy-Verified Reimbursement Index
finalists.one_liner: A furnisher-funded bureau, like a credit bureau for PBM payments, that turns what pharmacies actually pay and are actually paid into a reference index that state laws, Medicaid rate-setting and transparent-PBM contracts can cite, launching with a per-state Underwater Index sold to pharmacy associations for the 2027 legislative sessions.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I1266 ('Pharmacy-Side PBM Ledger for Employers'), type: 10x-or-inverted
finalists.cluster: Independent pharmacies squeezed by PBMs, refund floats and deserts

finalists.title: Serial Match: AP-Only Recovery for Exchange Buyers
finalists.one_liner: A success-fee audit that takes one accounts-payable export from an independent rotable pool or Part 145 station, finds money its repair vendors already owe, and collects it. It starts with credits the vendor has already conceded, then moves to repeat-failure claims.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0195 ('Contingency Recovery of Missed Rotable Repair Warranties'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Warranty claims left unfiled

finalists.title: Hall-Ready Gate for Liquid-Cooled GPU Tranches
finalists.one_liner: A fixed-price, 10-business-day release/hold decision, made 60-90 days before GPU delivery, on whether a liquid-cooled data hall will be energized and flowing when the racks arrive.
finalists.lineage: mutation of I0365 ('Ground-Truth Diligence for GPU-Backed Lenders'), type: sharpened
finalists.cluster: Investors, lenders and venues wanting real-economy ground truth

finalists.title: Tariff Surcharge Clawback for B2B Buyers
finalists.one_liner: A contingency-fee service that mines a buyer's 2025-26 supplier invoices for 'tariff surcharge' lines and recovers a share of the IEEPA refunds those suppliers are now collecting.
finalists.lineage: original (tournament survivor)
finalists.cluster: Recovering IEEPA tariff refunds and surcharges
